note: TVA campground on the French Broad River just below Douglas Dam, run under concession by Go Camp Tennessee (Vista Recreation), with a boat ramp, a fishing pier, a playground and a small store. The River Sites run in one long row along the bank; sites 7, 34 and 35 are too short for a 23-ft rig. Some sites are let long-term. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT: riverfront kept after a hard check. River: the French Broad River (Douglas Dam tailwater), ~150-200 m wide. Campspot sells 'River Site' 01-37 (+32B) by the night (2-night minimum); the operator's Campspot map puts them in one row along the bank. Esri imagery + 3DEP: pads e.g. 35.95714,-83.54878 (267.0 m), 35.95755,-83.54856 (267.6 m), 35.95793,-83.54816 (268.0 m), 35.95667,-83.54931 (268.1 m) sit ~10-25 m from the bank over open grass with scattered trees, ~0.5-1.6 m above the bank top and ~2.3-3.4 m above the water surface on a gentle slope - passes.
